name: pultec-air-without-fizz
description: The famous Pultec top-end move in isolation: boost a broad PEAK at 16 KCS for AIR while shelving the INDEPENDENT high-atten down at 10 KCS to pull the 3-8k 'fizz/harsh' region — so you get openness at the very top without brittleness. The HF boost frequency (KCS) and HF atten frequency (ATTEN SEL) are separate selectors with separate amounts; using both is the whole trick. Measured on the Watercolors drum loop: +2.7 dB @16k air with a ~-0.7 dB dip across 3-5k. For overheads/cymbals/bright bus/vocal tops/acoustic. Harness peak-normalizes to -1 dBFS; loudness-match before judging.
intended_for: overheads, cymbals, a bright drum bus, vocal/acoustic tops — anything that needs air/sheen at the very top but is harsh or fizzy in the 3-8k region
plugin_build: UADx 'uaudio_pultec_eqp-1a.vst3' (the UADx native build that RENDERS headless via Pedalboard; NOT the 'UAD Pultec EQP-1A.component'/Legacy twins, which pass audio through unprocessed offline). 12 params; low_freq/high_freq/hf_atten_freq/enable/output are STRING enums that must go through this setattr harness, not apply-vst-chain's float dict.
notes: AIR vs FIZZ: hf_boost @16 KCS lifts the extreme top (a broad proportional bell — q8 keeps it gentle); hf_atten @10 KCS is a HIGH-SHELF CUT hinging ~2k that pulls everything above it down. Boost wins at the very top (16k), atten wins through 3-8k → air + smooth.
Move the boost/atten frequencies for different flavors: boost @12 KCS (lower, less fragile air) + atten @5 KCS (more aggressive de-harsh, hinge ~1k), or atten @20 KCS to only shave the extreme top.
hf_q is BANDWIDTH (0=SHARP/tall/narrow, 10=BROAD/lower+wider). For air on a bus keep it broad (8-10); for focused presence on one source go sharper (and pick a lower KCS).
Adding a touch of the low-end trick (low_freq 60 CPS, lf_boost 3, lf_atten 3) turns this into a full smile. For drums specifically, see pultec-drum-lowend-glue.
Verify with measure-spectrum: expect a lift at 12-16k and a small dip across 3-8k, crest roughly held. A 0.00 delta means the .component twin loaded instead of uaudio_.
